name: rush-code
description: Rush Code — monorepo (apps/backend NestJS API + apps/frontend Next.js + apps/mobile Expo + postgres)

scripts.dev: bun scripts/dev/with-env.ts bunx nx run-many -t dev --parallel --output-style=stream
